provenance.asserts: byte_length and sha256_digest - verbatim: "The correct GBA BIOS file is exactly 16384 bytes long, and has the SHA256 hash fd2547724b505f487e6dcb29ec2ecff3af35a841a77ab2e85fd87350abd36570."

sha256_digest - lists SHA-256 fd2547724b505f487e6dcb29ec2ecff3af35a841a77ab2e85fd87350abd36570 for the standard GBA / GBA SP / Game Boy Micro / Game Boy Player BIOS, alongside SHA-1, MD5, and CRC-32. Hosts no BIOS file.

provenance.source: GBATEK (Martin Korth), canonical GBA technical reference
provenance.asserts: byte_length - states the BIOS ROM is 16 KBytes, address range 00000000-00003FFF (= 16384 bytes)

acquisition_path: none - this product never sources, links to, mirrors, or distributes BIOS content
